curation.name: Alpha Dynamic Walk
curation.summary: Standard bipedal walking gait with 50 Hz velocity tracking (vx, vy, yaw_rate) and active head-pose orientation control.
curation.details: The flagship locomotion policy for Microduck. Publisher materials describe MuJoCo training with a baked observation normalizer and Dynamixel XL330-oriented actuator modeling.
curation.notes: Publisher hardware and evaluation claims are not independent registry evidence.
